aiOverview.content: Rory McIlroy won his second consecutive green jacket at the 2026 Masters Tournament on Sunday, April 12, finishing at 13-under par to secure his 30th PGA Tour victory and sixth major championship. McIlroy defended his title against top contenders, including Scottie Scheffler and Cameron Young, with a crucial birdie on the 12th hole.2026 Masters Sunday Highlights:Champion: Rory McIlroy finished with a 2-under 70 on Sunday, overcoming a tight battle with Justin Rose and Cameron Young.Historic Win: McIlroy became only the fourth player in history to win back-to-back Masters tournaments.Drama: Sergio Garcia received a code-of-conduct warning—a rarity at Augusta—after damaging a tee box and breaking his driver on the second hole,.Key Moments: McIlroy secured his lead with birdies at Nos. 12 and 13 (Amen Corner).Top Finishers: Scottie Scheffler finished in solo second, with Justin Rose, Cameron Young, Tyrrell Hatton, and Russell Henley also in contention.Final round coverage was broadcast on CBS and Paramount+. Rory McIlroy won his second consecutive green jacket at the 2026 Masters Tournament on Sunday, April 12, finishing at 13-under par to secure his 30th PGA Tour victory and sixth major championship. McIlroy defended his title against top contenders, including Scottie Scheffler and Cameron Young, with a crucial birdie on the 12th hole. 2026 Masters Sunday Highlights: Champion: Rory McIlroy finished with a 2-under 70 on Sunday, overcoming a tight battle with Justin Rose and Cameron Young. Historic Win: McIlroy became only the fourth player in history to win back-to-back Masters tournaments. Drama: Sergio Garcia received a code-of-conduct warning—a rarity at Augusta—after damaging a tee box and breaking his driver on the second hole,. Key Moments: McIlroy secured his lead with birdies at Nos. 12 and 13 (Amen Corner). Top Finishers: Scottie Scheffler finished in solo second, with Justin Rose, Cameron Young, Tyrrell Hatton, and Russell Henley also in contention. Final round coverage was broadcast on CBS and Paramount+. Paramount+
